description: Promedio de tráfico y conexiones en zonas digitales de Acacías is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Acacías, Meta. Información de conexiones y tráfico de las zonas digitales del Municipio de Acacías. Coverage: Alcaldía de Acacías, Meta. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Acacías, Meta. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
